title: CBIC Clarifies IGST Payment for Raw Sugar Imports Under Advance Authorisation Converted to TRQ Scheme
content:
# CBIC Clarifies IGST Payment for Raw Sugar Imports Under Advance Authorisation Converted to TRQ Scheme

Ek important update hai for businesses importing raw sugar! The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ne raw sugar imports ke liye IGST payment procedure clear kar diya hai, especially jab Advance Authorisation (AA) Scheme ko Tariff Rate Quota (TRQ) Scheme mein convert kiya jaata hai.

*   **What's the Update?** CBIC ne Circular No. 37/2026-Cus dated August 27, 2026, issue kiya hai. Is circular mein उन importers ke liye modalities batai gayi hain jinhe Advance Authorisation ke under import kiye gaye raw sugar par IGST pay karna hai, after the AA is converted to a TRQ.
*   **Context:** Yeh clarification Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) dwara issue kiye gaye Notification No. 31/2026-27 dated August 20, 2026, aur Public Notice No. 27/2026-27 dated August 20, 2026, ke reference mein aaya hai. In notifications ne raw sugar ke import policy conditions ko amend kiya tha aur 10 Lakh MT TRQ ke allocation ke liye modalities prescribe ki thi, jismein AA se TRQ mein one-time conversion bhi shaamil hai.
*   **Procedure for IGST Payment:** Affected AA holders ko Port of Import (POI) ke concerned assessment group se contact karna hoga. Assessment group Bill of Entry (BE) ko reassess karke tax charge karega, jiske baad IGST Customs EDI System mein generate kiye gaye electronic challan ke through pay kiya jaayega. IGST payment ke baad, POI ek notional Out of Charge (OOC) karega taaki relevant details, including IGST amount and payment date, GSTN portal par transmit ho sake for ITC eligibility determination.
*   **Interest Waiver:** Importantly, circular ne clearly mention kiya hai ki IGST payment se arise hone wali koi bhi interest liability waive off kar di jaayegi.
